title: Null Run signature mobs for the three environment kits

behavior_families.latchwing: Existing class 15 CYBR family: telegraphed locked-direction dash. These six designs use it unchanged.
behavior_families.relay_choir: Existing class 16 PAIN family: anchored telegraphed slow three-projectile fan. These six designs use it unchanged.

notes: Art only. Six new identities use two existing behavior families; no new AI, actor IDs, frame mapping or mechanics are introduced.
A and B are two variants of the same design and behavior family; they differ in shape and detail, not merely color.
Codex owns behavior, labels, native frame mapping, collision and visual validation.
The atlases are static art: four frames per state, six states, 128x128 cells in a 512x768 RGBA sheet.

latchwing.name: SHELF WIDOW
latchwing.description: An ordinary bowed filing shelf that has learned to stand. Its front splits into a long, low negative-space body; paper folds become limbs and open drawers become wet mouths. It is found-object architecture first and an animal only when it unfolds.
latchwing.warning_notes: Warning is a slow separation of the cabinet face: drawer gaps widen, the dark interior lengthens, and folded paper limbs slide out. The locked-direction dash is shown as a low, committed lunge, never a teleport. Keep the empty cavity and drawer mouths readable at 128 px.
latchwing.limits: Existing latchwing family only: class 15 CYBR, telegraphed locked-direction dash. No new AI, phasing, teleportation, gaze or actor ID. Codex owns behavior and frame mapping.

relay_choir.name: REDACTED CHOIR
relay_choir.description: A hunched stack of waterlogged registrars and paper-veiled almost-faces. The blank regions are the point: no eyes, only seams and slowly rising ink pressure behind the paper. When it opens, three wet paper tongues fan out from the stack.
relay_choir.warning_notes: Warning is the ink level visibly climbing inside the blank face panels across four frames, with a copper pressure needle. It is slow, quiet and readable without a flash or a dark outline. The three-projectile fan is composed as three paper tongues, not a new mechanic.
relay_choir.limits: Existing relay_choir family only: class 16 PAIN, anchored telegraphed slow three-projectile fan. No new AI, projectile count, phasing or actor ID. Codex owns behavior and frame mapping.

latchwing.name: INSULATOR WIDOW
latchwing.description: A fluted ceramic and cable arthropod assembled from petticoat insulators, rust iron joints and heavy cable legs. Amber pressure glows between cracked ivory segments; it moves like a low, cautious machine that has been left energized too long.
latchwing.warning_notes: Warning separates the ceramic discs and shows amber pressure in the gaps while the cable legs coil. The dash is a stretched, low directional lunge with trailing cable, clearly different from the drowned shelf.
latchwing.limits: Existing latchwing family only: class 15 CYBR, telegraphed locked-direction dash. No new AI, electric damage, phasing or actor ID. Codex owns behavior and frame mapping.

relay_choir.name: TRANSFORMER CANTOR
relay_choir.description: A stationary radial insulator and conductor body: a rust iron core inside a crown of ivory ceramic fins, braided cable roots and small amber pressure gauges. It does not walk; it rotates, opens and sings a wide three-part fan.
relay_choir.warning_notes: Warning is a slow outward rotation of the fin crown, three amber pressure eyes rising and three ceramic nozzles extending. The three-projectile fan is the existing anchored relay pattern, shown as a spreading mechanical fan, not a new attack.
relay_choir.limits: Existing relay_choir family only: class 16 PAIN, anchored telegraphed slow three-projectile fan. No new AI, beam, chain lightning or actor ID. Codex owns behavior and frame mapping.

latchwing.name: QUEUE STALKER
latchwing.description: An empty folded service coat suspended on low articulated queue struts. The collar is an unfilled opening, the sleeves are flat pleats and a retractable belt hangs where an arm should be. It moves in short, over-civil scuttles.
latchwing.warning_notes: Warning unfolds the coat into a wider baffle, lifts the empty sleeves and opens the collar while the struts spread. The lunge is a low, compressed dash; the silhouette stays a coat and stand, never a soldier.
latchwing.limits: Existing latchwing family only: class 15 CYBR, telegraphed locked-direction dash. No new AI, possession, phasing or actor ID. Codex owns behavior and frame mapping.

relay_choir.name: USHER CLUSTER
relay_choir.description: A split-faced unattended ticket and usher arrangement: overlapping kiosk faces, folded brass baffles and three empty apertures of different sizes. The symmetry is deliberately broken; nothing inside the apertures is shown.
relay_choir.warning_notes: Warning unfolds the brass baffles and widens the empty apertures while small brass pressure flags rise. The three dark apertures become the three-tongue fan of the existing anchored relay pattern. No fake portal or gaze is drawn.
relay_choir.limits: Existing relay_choir family only: class 16 PAIN, anchored telegraphed slow three-projectile fan. No new AI, portal, gaze or actor ID. Codex owns behavior and frame mapping.
